draft.shortGloss: to be surprised; to be startled
draft.emotion: wide-eyed and breathless, reacting to a sudden shock
notes: Often used with the adverb 깜짝 (깜짝 놀라다, to be startled) and takes the particle 에 for the cause of surprise (소리에 놀라다).
Do not confuse with 놀리다 (to tease) or 놀다 (to play/hang out).
